results.description:
Pizza Ready! – Build a Restaurant Empire!

Welcome to Pizza Ready, a pizza game where you cook, serve, manage, and build a growing restaurant business. Start with one shop, take every customer order, and turn a small kitchen into a busy business empire. If you love food, idle, simulator, and tycoon gameplay, this game is for you.

Cook, Serve, and Grow

Prepare fresh pizza for every customer and keep the restaurant moving fast. Take each order, complete each order, cook food in the kitchen, add tasty topping, and serve a delicious meal before the line gets too long. Every order gives you money, profit, and a chance to upgrade your shop.

As owner and manager, you control the restaurant from counter to kitchen. Manage each station, improve every recipe, master the flow, and serve more customers. The better you manage your business, the faster your restaurant can expand.

Upgrade Kitchen, Equipment, and Staff

Build a stronger kitchen with better equipment, ovens, appliances, and stations. Each upgrade helps you prepare more meals, complete more orders, and make your restaurant more efficient. Upgrade equipment, unlock fresh ingredients, upgrade each dish, and create delicious food that every customer will enjoy.

Hire chef and cashier staff to keep the shop running. Train your staff, increase order speed, and help every customer faster. Great staff, better equipment, and smart management help your business earn income, even while you are offline.

Become a Pizza Tycoon

Pizza Ready combines idle simulator gameplay with restaurant management and business growth. Collect money, boost profit, and unlock each level as your restaurant becomes bigger. Expand your store, design a better shop layout, and build an empire across new locations.

Every level brings a new challenge. Open another restaurant, upgrade every station, serve more customers, and become the ultimate pizza tycoon. Whether you enjoy a relaxing idle game, restaurant simulator game, clicker progress, or tapping game fun, Pizza Ready gives you a satisfying business journey.

Features

Build and manage your pizza restaurant, cook food, serve every customer, complete each order, earn money, upgrade kitchen equipment, grow business profit, hire staff, expand your shop, and enjoy idle progress online or offline.

Download Pizza Ready. Cook delicious pizza, manage every order, upgrade your kitchen, expand your business, and become the greatest pizza tycoon!

Welcome to Burger Please!, the ultimate restaurant simulation game where cooking becomes your path to building a global fast-food empire. Step into a lively kitchen filled with sizzling ingredients, satisfying meals, and endless challenges designed for anyone who loves cooking. Whether you've dreamed of running a food shop, becoming a master of hamburger crafting, or expanding your own international franchise, this game lets you create that success story through nonstop cooking fun.

▶ Build Your Fast-Food Shop & Burger Empire
Start with a small restaurant counter and transform it into a world-famous restaurant. Each day introduces new customers, new cooking tasks, and new management challenges. You’ll prepare meals, side dishes, and even add pizza to your growing food menu. Every upgrade strengthens your brand and expands your burger empire across the globe.

▶ Cook & Serve a Variety of Food Items
Become the town’s rising cookmaster through nonstop cooking action! Grill burger patties, stack ingredients, and serve delicious food to hungry customers. As your menu grows, you'll handle hot pizzas alongside classic burger orders, balancing speed, creativity, and efficient cooking. Making everything from premium hamburger plates to fresh pizza variations creates the ultimate addictive loop for fans of fast-food management.

▶ Upgrade, Expand & Run the Perfect Restaurant Shop
Turn your humble counter into a full drive-thru shop by upgrading machines, equipment, and staff abilities. Faster service means more satisfied customers and more profit to reinvest. Open new branches, unlock new burger levels, and introduce additional food categories—including special pizza menus

▶ Hire, Train & Manage a Skilled Team
No chef grows alone! Recruit staff, train them, and improve their performance with smart management. A strong team helps you handle rush hours, maintain clean tables, and serve everything from fries and drinks to premium hamburger and burger meals. With the right strategy, your fast-food business scales faster than ever.

▶ Face Daily Challenges & Special Events
Delivery orders, VIP guests, sudden crowds, and special pizza events keep your cooking journey exciting. Every challenge tests your timing and fast-food management skills. Handle them well and earn bonuses, unlock upgrades, and push your burger franchise to new heights.

▶ Expand Your Menu Beyond Burgers
Why limit yourself to burger dishes? Add pizza, snacks, and more food varieties to become a true master of fast-food cooking. Each expansion introduces new levels, customer types, and opportunities to showcase your talent. With engaging gameplay and deep management mechanics,

Become the master chef who serves burger, fries, pizza, and every popular fast-food favorite to customers around the world. Download Burger Please! today and prove you can run the most iconic restaurant and build a legendary burger franchise!

► A GAME TO KEEP YOU FULLY OCCUPIED

Ever dreamed of running your own hotel? Start from the ground up in this fun and fast-paced time-management game where the aim is to build an accommodation empire and demonstrate your dedication to hospitality. Show your skills as a hotel manager, invest wisely in staff and property improvements, and work your socks off to become a hospitality tycoon in this addictive and entertaining casual simulator.

► FIRST-CLASS SERVICE

• Climb to the top: Start the game as a simple bellhop single-handedly cleaning rooms, greeting guests at reception, collecting payments and tips, and keeping the bathroom stocked with toilet paper. As your bank balance expands, upgrade rooms and facilities, and employ new staff to help keep up with the growing demand at your hotel. Your guests may be sleeping comfortably, but there’s no time to rest for a determined hotel tycoon.

• Build an empire: There are several hotels to explore and expand, each with dozens of different unique upgrades to make before you reach five-star perfection. Demonstrate your competence as a manager in each location, then get promoted to get a new and bigger property, and continue your path to becoming a true hotel tycoon. Each hotel has its own style and atmosphere too.

• Keep going: If you want success in this high-stakes industry, you can’t just stroll around your property at a leisurely pace. Upgrade your and your employees’ movement speed to work faster and provide your guests with all the services they need ASAP — it’ll boost your revenue too.

• Amenities are the answer: Maximise profits and get more funds to invest in this fun simulator by ensuring your hotels have all available amenities. Bathrooms are the first step, but work hard and you’ll soon have the opportunity to add vending machines, restaurants, parking lots, and swimming pools to your properties. Guests will pay extra for each facility, boosting your revenue. Though remember each facility also needs staffing, so get hiring or you’ll soon run off your feet with angry guests left standing in line for each amenity.

• Grand designs: Upgrade accommodation to improve guests’ experience of your property and choose from a range of different room designs in each location. In this engaging simulator, you’re not just a manager, you’re an interior designer too!

► FIVE-STAR FUN

Looking for a time-management game that’s original and simple to play and provides endless hours of entertainment? Dive straight into the fast-paced world of hospitality provision and develop your skills as a manager, investor, and designer. Download Hotel Master now and get to work building an accommodation empire.

Outlets Rush: So Addictive, You'll Forget Your Shoe Size!

Transform into the ultimate retail tycoon in Outlets Rush –Dive into the strategic time management gameplay and become the boss of your personalized shopping city. Play now for an immersive experience that combines tycoon mastery, idle thrills, and mega shopping excitement!                      
                                
► Tap, Build, Repeat:
In this idle game, simplicity is key! Tap your way to success as you build and expand your outlets from mini to mega. It's easy, it's fun, and it's all about the joy of watching your mall grow with minimal effort!

► Various Stores & Products:
Explore iconic sports shops, luxury stores, and a plethora of items found in real outlets - shoes, clothes, bags, hats, underwear, and more. Each store brings a unique concept and a delightful variety of items for your customers to discover.

► Effortless Management:
Become a retail tycoon without breaking a sweat! Effortlessly manage your dream mall by hiring staff and making strategic decisions. Deal with displaying goods, cleaning fitting rooms, and helping customers check out. Fear not, for you can build your own dream team and manage them efficiently, turning challenges into opportunities and making every coin count!

► Mini to Mega, Instantly:
Experience the joy of instant growth as you transform mini outlets into mega shopping extravaganzas in the blink of an eye. It's the managerial journey you've been waiting for, with surprises around every corner!

BUILD YOUR DREAM TOWN!

Welcome to Township, a thrilling city-building and farming game where you become the mayor of your own town!
Build houses, factories, and community buildings, grow crops on your farm, and decorate your town just the way you like. Take part in limited-time events, compete in exciting regattas, and earn exclusive prizes!

Need a break from city planning? Jump into relaxing match-3 puzzles to earn rewards, speed up your progress, and unlock even more fun - all available offline!
Township - the perfect blend of city-building, farming, and match-3 gameplay!

GAME FEATURES:
● Unlimited creativity: Design and build the metropolis of your dreams!
● Engaging match-3 puzzles: Complete fun levels to earn rewards and boost your progress!
● Exciting competitions: Test your skills against players from around the world in regular competitions - win prizes and make unforgettable memories!
● Exclusive collections: Gather valuable artifacts, rare antiquities, and colorful profile pictures to showcase your achievements!
● Offline play: Enjoy Township anytime, anywhere - even without an internet connection!
● Vibrant community: Meet friendly characters with unique personalities!
● Social connections: Play with your Facebook and Game Center friends or make new friends in the Township community!

Why You'll Love Township:
● A unique mix of city-building, farming, and match-3 gameplay!
● Stunning graphics and charming animations
● Regular updates with fresh content and special events
● Personalize your town with a wide variety of decorations

Township is free to play, but some in-game elements (including randomized items) can be purchased for real money. If you don't want to take advantage of this option, simply turn it off in your device's Restrictions menu.

A Wi-Fi or internet connection is not required to play.
*An internet connection is required to access competitions and additional features.

Do you like Township? Follow us!
Facebook: facebook.com/TownshipMobile
Instagram: instagram.com/township_mobile/

Need to report an issue or ask a question? Contact Player Support through the game by going to Settings > Help and Support. If you can't access the game, use the web chat by clicking the chat icon in the lower right corner of our website: https://playrix.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-township/

My Mini Mart: Your Pocket-Sized Business Empire

Become the Ultimate Retail Tycoon!

Embark on a fun and challenging journey as you build and manage your very own mini mart. From humble beginnings to a bustling retail empire, the choices are yours!

How to Play:

Farm Fresh: Plant seeds, water crops, and harvest fresh produce.
Animal Husbandry: Raise animals like chickens and cows for eggs and milk.
Processing Power: Use machines to transform raw materials into finished products.
Staff Management: Hire and train employees to handle various tasks.
Customer Satisfaction: Keep your shelves stocked and customers happy to boost profits.
Strategic Expansion: Upgrade your store, unlock new products, and expand your business.

Key Features:

Farming Freshness: Cultivate a variety of crops, from vibrant fruits to hearty vegetables, to supply your store with the freshest produce.
Animal Husbandry: Tend to adorable animals like chickens and cows, gathering eggs and milk to create delicious dairy products.
Manufacturing Magic: Transform raw materials into delectable treats and essential goods using a range of processing machines.
Strategic Staffing: Hire and train a team of hardworking employees to assist with various tasks, from stocking shelves to serving customers.
Expansive Upgrades: Expand your mini mart, upgrade equipment, and unlock new products to attract more customers and boost your profits.
Time Management Mastery: Balance multiple tasks simultaneously, making strategic decisions to optimize efficiency and maximize revenue.
Relaxing Gameplay: Enjoy a calming and satisfying experience as you watch your mini mart thrive and grow.

Are you ready to take on the challenge of running a successful business? Download My Mini Mart today and start your retail adventure!
